description.p: Termi is a native Linux terminal emulator built with Rust and Slint for Ubuntu 24.04 on x86-64. It provides independent PTY-backed tabs in a polished galactic desktop interface.

ul.li: ANSI, 256-color, true-color, Unicode, and wide-cell rendering
Searchable scrollback and guarded clipboard paste
Application mouse modes and alternate-screen programs
Strict local configuration and optional Bash integration

description.p: Initial production release candidate for Ubuntu 24.04 x86-64.
